testimonials.name: Ashkan Eliasy
testimonials.role: Founder & Managing Director, Nuvisy Strategic Advisory
testimonials.context: Managed Adegbite directly at Ocuwell · Jul 2023
testimonials.text: Adegbite was a key player in developing Ocuwell's HealthTech frontend web app. He works with great attention to detail, making sure every task is done right, and is good at spotting and fixing issues before they become big problems. His communication is clear and timely, and his technical and teamwork skills make him a standout, reliable contributor.

testimonials.text: Famosa was an instrumental member of my software engineering team, where he worked with me for a year and a half on a project for Indeed. He consistently demonstrated exceptional technical skills, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results, with a positive, collaborative approach that made him a pleasure to work with.
